text:
maya: Quick sync — PR #4897 is the release-notes + model-catalog changes for the upcoming patch. Need reviewers for the deprecation/migration section and someone to sign off on the docs preview. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4897
rachael: I can take the migration guide and quick sanity-check the prose. ETA end of day PT.
kevin: I’ll run the SDK/Code Snippet tests (JS + Python) — ping me when CI preview is up.
sam_k: docs-bot posted preview: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/preview/4897 (auto-build)
ci-bot: preview build started for PR #4897 — job: docs-build-12. logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/9881
maya: Plan proposal: merge in a staggered flow — 1) merge release-notes, 2) wait 10m, 3) merge catalog entry that marks redwood-base-v1 deprecated, 4) publish changelog. Prefer doing this during 14:00-16:00 PT quiet window. Thoughts?
alejandra: Heads-up: catalog entry marks model "redwood-base-v1" deprecated. Please include a migration snippet showing how to pin to the compat model (inline code). Suggested snippet: `client.generate({model: "redwood-compat-v2", prompt})`
kevin: Running snippet tests now — failure in python example: missing dependency error in requirements.txt (aiohttp 3.8.3). Quick fix: update docs/requirements.txt to pin aiohttp>=3.8.4.
ci-bot: docs-build-12 failed: `ERROR: Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement aiohttp==3.8.3` — see full log https://ci.redwood.ai/build/9881/logs
kevin: pushed fix to the PR (updated requirements + added a tiny test). Triggering rebuild.
ci-bot: rebuild triggered, docs-build-13 started — ETA ~3m.
ci-bot: docs-build-13 succeeded — artifacts: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/preview/4897 (updated)
sam_k: Preview looks good. One formatting nit: move the migration note into a "Breaking changes" subsection so it shows up in the sidebar callout. Also add a short code comment showing how to set the model pin in the JS SDK: `const res = await client.text.generate({model: "redwood-compat-v2"})`
rachael: Reviewed the migration text. Left two tiny wording nits in-line (clarify 'compat' → 'compatibility model'). Approving once those are adjusted. :thumbsup:
maya: Thanks — I made the wording tweak and moved the section. CI is green. Next: who will press merge and watch for any formatting regressions after the stagger?
sam_k: I can merge the release-notes at 14:05 PT and monitor the preview. If it looks good after 10m, I'll merge the catalog change.
kevin: I’ll be on standby to check SDK snippets in prod docs after the merge.
maya: ok merging window set. If anything breaks, revert with `git revert <merge-commit>` and ping #eng-oncall.
sam_k: Merged release-notes at 14:05 PT.
deploy-bot: docs site: deploy started for commit f3a1b9c — job id deploy-2234
sam_k: Waited 10m, preview stable, merging catalog deprecation entry now.
deploy-bot: catalog update deploy started for commit b7d2c1a — job id deploy-2235
ci-bot: smoke check passed for both deploys. No broken links reported.
rachael: Approved — migration guide looks good in live preview.
alejandra: Added the compat example to the top of the migration page. Good to ship.
maya: Awesome — thanks everyone. I’ll add a short callout in the release notes channel and raise a PR for the changelog rollup.
sam_k: Closing loop: PR #4897 merged and deployed. Will follow up if any regressions crop up.
deploy-bot: all deploy steps completed successfully (deploy-2234, deploy-2235)
